title: bar-flow-v1
description: One non-empty CLOSED bar-flow record with exact taker buy/sell volume. Runtime enforces their non-negative sum equals total volume. State, availability and provenance belong to the evidence-backed result envelope.

bucket_start.description: Canonical UTC start of the half-open bucket and the candle record time.

bucket_end.description: UTC end equals bucket_start plus the BarFlowDefinition duration; runtime validation required.

open.description: Exact decimal price of the first trade in the canonical source order, serialized without exponent or trailing fractional zeroes.

high.description: Exact decimal maximum of source trade prices, never compared as strings or binary floats.

low.description: Exact decimal minimum of source trade prices, never compared as strings or binary floats.

close.description: Exact decimal price of the last trade in the canonical source order, serialized without exponent or trailing fractional zeroes.

volume.description: Exact decimal sum of source trade sizes, serialized without exponent or trailing fractional zeroes and without implicit rounding.

trade_count.description: Exact count of source trade records in this non-empty bucket, serialized as a non-zero canonical decimal digit string to avoid JSON number precision loss.

taker_buy_volume.description: Exact non-negative taker_buy_volume; zero is valid when all trades aggress the opposite side.

taker_sell_volume.description: Exact non-negative taker_sell_volume; zero is valid when all trades aggress the opposite side.

utc_timestamp.description: UTC RFC 3339 instant with Z suffix and up to nine fractional digits. Canonical output omits a zero fraction and trims trailing fractional zeroes.

positive_digit_string.description: A positive integer in canonical decimal spelling, with no leading zeroes.

positive_normalized_decimal.description: A strictly positive finite decimal with no sign, exponent, leading zeroes or trailing fractional zeroes.
